title: Openergy vs Synergy on macOS
subtitle: Recorded measurements on Apple silicon, macOS 27.2. Lower is better. 1 MiB = 1,024 KiB.
footnote: Same Mac (M5 Pro, macOS 27.2) and role: client of the same Windows server, windows closed.
Memory: Synergy service + tray + core (2026-10-21); Openergy app + daemon (2026-10-25). Not a lab benchmark.

synergy.source: docs/re/04-tray-security-packaging.md, sum of 3 processes, highest of 3 samples

openergy.source: maintainer measurement, installed app 42,480 KiB + daemon 23,520 KiB, client role connected, windows closed, 5 samples
